name: ParameterizedTest
summary: Takes the values that differ as arguments, so that several test conditions share one body instead of one copy each.

roles.name: ParameterizedTest
roles.summary: A test method whose data comes from outside it. The trade is stated by the pattern itself: one body to maintain, at the price that a failure names a row rather than a case — so the arguments have to identify themselves, or the report says nothing.
